key_findings: The newest Ubuntu LTS release is Ubuntu 26.04 LTS, codenamed 'Resolute Raccoon' (sources: fetch-73b01100ef81, web-7ee57676b775).
Ubuntu 26.04 LTS was released in April 2026, as the version number reflects the year and month of delivery (sources: fetch-984431d206d8, fetch-154212e72052, fetch-73b01100ef81).
Ubuntu 26.04 LTS is described as the 11th long-term supported release of Ubuntu and is available to download from ubuntu.com/download (source: fetch-73b01100ef81).
LTS releases are published every two years and receive 5 years of standard security maintenance (source: fetch-4d8e62de747a).
gaps: The evidence does not state the exact calendar date (specific day) in April 2026 on which Ubuntu 26.04 LTS shipped.
The evidence does not specify whether the release-cycle documentation page confirms Ubuntu 26.04 LTS specifically, or only describes the general LTS cadence.

value.text: The newest Ubuntu long-term-support release is Ubuntu 26.04 LTS, codenamed "Resolute Raccoon," which Canonical announced as the 11th long-term supported release, available to download from ubuntu.com/download. The version number reflects the year and month of delivery, April 2026. LTS releases are published every two years and receive 5 years of standard security maintenance.
